compose:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx:1.27
    logging:
      driver: local
      options:
        max-size: 1m
    deploy:
      update_config:
        parallelism: 2
      rollback_config:
        order: stop-first
  db:
    image: postgres:17
    volumes:
      - data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    deploy:
      placement:
        constraints:
          - node.hostname == x
  cache:
    image: redis:7
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: cache
        target: /data
    deploy:
      update_config:
        order: start-first
volumes:
  data: {}
  cache: {}
